sentences.text: This end-of-well review covers wellbore 15/9-F-15 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea.
The review was written without access to the field data tools, so it states no measured depths, dates, durations, hole sizes or volumes for this wellbore.
Any quantitative statement about the well should be taken from the checked drilling database rather than from this narrative.
The hole-section breakdown of 15/9-F-15 (section numbers, hole sizes, start and end depths and casing shoes) is not restated here and should be read from the wellbore's section records.
Section-level drilling rates and interruption hours likewise need to be pulled from the activity and section tables before any comparison between sections is made.
Lost-time analysis for the well should separate primary and possible lost-time tiers so that the two are not merged in the reported totals.
Activity codes, campaign structure and operation phases should be taken from the daily report records, with the first unflagged report used as the start of the operational timeline.
Real-time curve statistics for 15/9-F-15 were not available to this review and are not reported.
The next revision should add the verified totals for depth, duration, lost time and fluid volumes once the data are queried and checked.
